meta.description: Community-maintained MLB injury database for National League stars

ronald-acuna-jr.name: Ronald Acuña Jr.

current_injury.type: Left hamstring strain (recurring); left fibula fracture (non-displaced, 2026)
current_injury.mechanism: Strained hamstring running to first base; left fibula non-displaced fracture suffered Mar 3, 2026 in Spring Training
current_injury.severity: Moderate to severe (hamstring Grade 1 recurring; fibula fracture non-displaced)
current_injury.details: Left hamstring strain — 2nd occurrence this season. Placed on 10-day IL June 9. Currently rehabbing with FCL Braves. Hit grand slam in 3rd rehab game (projected 423 ft, 112.8 mph). Only DH in rehab; not yet cleared for outfield. Left fibula non-displaced fracture suffered Mar 3, 2026 in Spring Training. On 60-day IL rehabbing since April 2026.

pre_injury_stats.rbis: 22 (5 RBIs in rehab grand slam game)

ronald-acuna-jr.notes: First injury-shortened season since 2023 ACL tear. Rehab Gate watch critical: must progress BP → live pitching → straight-line running → cutting → MiLB rehab → MLB activation. Any setback at cutting stage could push return to August. Braves manager Walt Weiss: 'He's probably as strong as he's ever been.'

latest_update.event: Hit grand slam in 3rd FCL rehab game (423 ft, 112.8 mph). Went 0-for-3 with walk and 5 RBIs. Only DH — not yet in outfield. No confirmed rehab timeline.

mookie-betts.name: Mookie Betts

current_injury.type: Stiff lower back (Jul 11) + Right wrist soreness (resolved Jul 2) + Post-viral fatigue
current_injury.mechanism: Stiff lower back not from specific incident. Wrist soreness resolved after treatment. Residual fatigue from viral illness (late July 2025 — ~25 lbs loss).
current_injury.details: Out 3+ games as of Jul 13 (back). Dave Roberts: 'He's feeling a little better.' NOT expected on IL for back or wrist. Conservative day-to-day management. Residual fatigue from severe viral illness in late July 2025 that caused ~25 lbs weight loss (175 → 150 lbs) and death of stepfather.

rehab_timeline.viral_care: New medication prescribed; putting food down; full workout completed at Dodger Stadium

injury_history.return_status: Returned; 150 lbs, manager says 'turned a corner'

mookie-betts.notes: Most tumultuous recent stretch in recent memory for a star player: broken wrist, oblique strain (x2), severe illness, personal loss, back stiffness. All major injuries resolved. No IL expected for back or wrist. Conservative treatment; 7-game hitting streak (.355).

latest_update.event: Severe viral illness causing ~25 lbs weight loss. Back stiffness day-to-day. Resumed offseason workout at Dodger Stadium. New medication helping. Manager Roberts: 'He feels great. Expects to play. Right now we're in a good spot.' On 7-game hit streak.

freddie-freeman.name: Freddie Freeman

current_injury.type: No acute injury currently. Neck stinger (resolved Aug 2025). Chronic ankle managed. Left rib/scar tissue (March 2025 — resolved).
current_injury.mechanism: Neck stinger from neck into right shoulder (Aug 2025). Chronic ankle from previous sprains. March 2025 left rib/scar tissue re-aggravated during BP for Tokyo opener.
current_injury.details: No acute injury currently preventing play. Neck stinger fully resolved. Chronic left ankle from June 2025 sprain managed with load management and treatment. March 2025 left rib/scar tissue issue was minor and resolved quickly. 75% certainty of playing through rib discomfort.

rehab_timeline.expected_return: N/A — Currently active and playing regularly
rehab_timeline.ankle_management: Ongoing with load management; occasional flare-ups monitored

freddie-freeman.notes: Chronic ankle issues (right debridement Dec 2024, left sprain Jun 2025) require ongoing monitoring. Walk-Off Grand Slam in 2024 WS legend despite injuries. Freeman is the most durable of the three tracked players. 2025: leading MLB in softball grounds, 30 SB in first 300 ABs, 25.9% walk rate. Lineup impact: Freeman moved to 2nd spot behind Ohtani after Betts' return.

latest_update.event: Out vs. Reds Wednesday with neck stinger (neck into right shoulder). Returned to lineup Friday with no lingering effects. Dave Roberts: 'He feels a lot better. There's still some kind of lingering effects, but nothing compromising... I feel confident that he can get through it and won't have any setbacks.'
